tables.name: meta
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: bom_items
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bom_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  quantity REAL NOT NULL,
  category TEXT,
  supplier TEXT,
  part_number TEXT,
  lcsc_part TEXT,
  price REAL,
  in_stock REAL,
 min_stock REAL,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  manufacturer TEXT,
  customer_no TEXT,
  package TEXT,
  rohs TEXT,
  ext_price REAL,
  lead_time INTEGER,
  date_code_lot_no TEXT,
  status TEXT,
 pcb_designation TEXT,
 item_image TEXT
)

tables.name: projects
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Draft',
  git TEXT,
  web TEXT,
  pcb_quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  pcb_cost REAL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: files
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT,
  item_id TEXT,
  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  filepath TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_type TEXT,
  size INTEGER,
  title TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES bom_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

tables.name: project_items
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES bom_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE(project_id, item_id)
)

tables.name: activity
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activity (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: notifications
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT DEFAULT 'info',
  is_read INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: settings
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',
  items_per_page INTEGER DEFAULT 20,
  language TEXT DEFAULT 'es',
  decimals INTEGER DEFAULT 2,
  theme TEXT DEFAULT 'light',
  country TEXT DEFAULT 'ES',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: stock_movements
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity REAL NOT NULL,
  previous_stock REAL NOT NULL,
  new_stock REAL NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES bom_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

tables.name: tags
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  color TEXT DEFAULT '#3B82F6',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: item_tags
tables.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS item_tags (
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (item_id, tag_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES bom_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
